text_blocks.snippet: Tax cuts for workers can take various forms, including reductions in income tax rates, increases in standard deductions, expanded tax credits, and elimination of taxes on certain types of income. These measures aim to increase workers' disposable income and boost the economy.

list.title: Lowering income tax rates:
list.snippet: Reducing the percentage of income that workers pay in federal income taxes can significantly increase their take-home pay.

list.title: Increasing the standard deduction:
list.snippet: A larger standard deduction means that a bigger portion of a worker's income is not subject to federal income tax, leading to lower overall tax liability.
